context.zh: 数学对照 · 规则路径与不规则游走
context.en: MATHEMATICAL COMPARISON · ORDERED AND WANDERING PATHS

parameters.zh: 选择一种已整理好的起点

title.zh: 三颗恒星，一直相互牵引
title.en: Three stars, always pulling on one another

intro.zh: 先对照八字与等边旋转，再看从等边起点稍作改变后的不规则游走。三组都按牛顿引力逐步计算，不是前一章 KOI-5 的观测轨道，也不能代表所有三星系统。半透明标记显示 C 的起点再移动极少一点后，另一轮计算如何分开。
intro.en: Compare the figure eight and rotating triangle, then a wandering path started near the triangle. All three are integrated step by step under Newtonian gravity. They are neither KOI-5's observed orbits from the previous chapter nor universal triple-star paths. Translucent markers show a second calculation started with C shifted by one more tiny amount.

wander.zh: 不规则游走 · 微扰对照

presetNote.zh: 八字与等边旋转是两种特别整齐的路径。三组案例的质量与起点都已固定，后续运动仍由引力逐步计算。
presetNote.en: The figure eight and rotating triangle are two unusually ordered paths. All three cases have fixed masses and starting conditions; gravity still determines every subsequent step.

wanderNote.zh: 这一组从等边起点稍移 C 的位置和速度；切换时自动叠加另一轮更微小的起点改动。没有随机力，也没有预画轨道。两轮逐渐分开，能说明对初值敏感；某段时间看似不规则，不能据此证明它永远稳定或严格判定混沌。
wanderNote.en: This case slightly changes C's starting position and speed from the triangle. Selecting it also overlays a second run with an even smaller starting shift. No random force or prerecorded path is used. The runs separate, showing sensitivity to initial conditions; irregular motion over a finite interval does not prove lasting stability or establish chaos on its own.

position.zh: C 初始 x 的改变量 · L₀
position.en: Change in C’s initial x · L₀

velocity.zh: C 初始 vx 的改变量 · L₀/T₀
velocity.en: Change in C’s initial vx · L₀/T₀

ready.zh: 正在边演示边计算。虚线是刚刚走过的路，越早越淡；可随时暂停或回看最近 20 T₀。
ready.en: Integrating as the stars move. Dashed trails fade with age. Pause at any time or revisit the latest 20 T₀.

modified.zh: 已选定案例。点击“开始 / 继续”逐步计算引力；切换案例会从新起点重新开始。
modified.en: Case selected. Choose Start / continue to integrate gravity; changing cases restarts from new initial conditions.

close.zh: 近遇停止：至少一轮计算的间距过小，或本步无法分辨局部引力变化。两轮只比较共同的已解析时段；这不代表碰撞已发生。
close.en: Close-encounter stop: at least one run approached too closely or exceeded the local time-resolution limit. Only their shared resolved interval is shown; this is not a detected collision.

accuracy.zh: 误差停止：至少一轮的相对能量误差将超过 0.1%，已舍弃该步。只展示两轮共同的可信计算时段。
accuracy.en: Accuracy stop: the next step in at least one run would exceed 0.1% relative energy error, so it was rejected. Only the shared accepted interval is displayed.

paused.zh: 已暂停。可以回看已保存的历史，或继续演示。
paused.en: Paused. Review the saved history or continue the demonstration.

scrub.zh: 最近 20 T₀ 的历史 · 回看后可继续向前
scrub.en: Latest 20 T₀ of history · review, then continue

compareNote.zh: 半透明 A′、B′、C′ 是另一次计算中的同名恒星。两轮起点只差一点，起初几乎重合，后来可能分开；它们不是星体外层，也不是同时存在的六颗星。
compareNote.en: Translucent A′, B′ and C′ are the same three stars in a separate run. The starts differ slightly: the stars nearly overlap at first, then may separate. These are neither stellar shells nor six stars in one system.

legend.zh: A 金色 · B 蓝色 · C 珊瑚色｜实心 A、B、C 是本组计算的当前位置，半透明 A′、B′、C′ 是可选的另一轮微扰计算。游走案例保留最近 8 T₀ 的虚线，另外两组保留 3.6 T₀；越旧越淡，不预画未来轨道。
legend.en: A gold · B blue · C coral | Solid stars mark the base run; translucent A′, B′ and C′ mark the optional perturbed run. Dashed trails retain the latest 8 T₀ in the wandering case and 3.6 T₀ in the other two. Older segments fade; no future path is drawn.

scale.zh: 同一惯性平面、线性等比例坐标。物体接近画面边缘时视野扩大，不追踪单颗星；恒星盘和光晕是放大的辨认标记，不表示实际半径。
scale.en: One inertial plane with equal linear axis scales. The view expands when bodies approach its edge, without following one star. Enlarged stellar disks and halos identify bodies; they are not physical radii.

crossing.zh: 轨迹线交叉只表示不同时间经过同一片画面；碰撞必须在同一时刻、同一空间位置让真实星体表面接触。这里的星盘是放大的标记，无法据此判定相撞。
crossing.en: Crossing trail lines mark places visited at different times. A collision requires physical stellar surfaces to meet at the same time and place. These disks are enlarged markers, so the drawing cannot diagnose a collision.

collision.zh: 真实近遇可能只是偏转、交换伴星或出现质量转移；在足够近的条件下，恒星也可能合并并抛出物质。密集星团中已找到与合并有关的蓝离散星。结果还取决于星体类型、半径、速度和潮汐。本实验的近遇保护会先停止，不推演合并、爆炸或黑洞生成。
collision.en: A real close encounter may deflect stars, exchange companions or lead to mass transfer. If close enough, stars can also merge and expel matter; dense clusters contain blue stragglers linked to mergers. Outcomes depend on stellar type, radius, speed and tides. This experiment stops at its resolution guard and does not calculate mergers, explosions or black-hole formation.

preview.zh: 初始位置 · 尚无轨迹

energy.zh: 相对能量误差 · 当前 / 已回看窗口最大
energy.en: Relative energy error · now / reviewed-window max

initialNote.zh: 每行依次为质量、位置 (x, y)、速度 (vx, vy)。下表是整体平移/匀速变换后的质心系数值。扰动轮在修改 C 的 x 后独立做同样变换；不是给每一帧加偏移。
initialNote.en: Each row lists mass, position (x, y), then velocity (vx, vy), after a uniform translation and velocity shift to the center-of-mass frame. The perturbed run repeats that transformation after changing C’s x; no offset is added to later frames.

units.zh: 单位：选定长度 L₀、质量 M₀，时间 T₀ = √(L₀³ / GM₀)，于是数值 G = 1。时间 20 指 20 T₀，不是 20 秒或年。
units.en: Units: choose L₀ and M₀, then T₀ = √(L₀³ / GM₀), giving numerical G = 1. A duration of 20 means 20 T₀, not 20 seconds or years.

method.zh: 牛顿点质量模型：aᵢ = Σⱼ≠ᵢ mⱼ(rⱼ−rᵢ)/|rⱼ−rᵢ|³。固定步长 velocity-Verlet，Δt = 0.001 T₀，随播放逐步积分。每 0.02 T₀ 记录一帧，循环缓冲只保留最近 20 T₀；状态持续推进，不循环播放预先算好的片段。
method.en: Newtonian point masses: aᵢ = Σⱼ≠ᵢ mⱼ(rⱼ−rᵢ)/|rⱼ−rᵢ|³. Fixed-step velocity-Verlet advances during playback with Δt = 0.001 T₀. One frame is saved every 0.02 T₀; a circular buffer retains the latest 20 T₀. The state continues forward, not looping a precomputed clip.

limits.zh: 没有引力软化。若任一对间距低于 0.04 L₀，或 Δt > 0.03√(r³/(mᵢ+mⱼ))，就停止；也检查每一步漂移段的最近距离。能量误差超过 0.1% 前停止。这里没有恒星碰撞、潮汐、相对论或观测数据拟合。
limits.en: No gravitational softening. Stop if any pair is closer than 0.04 L₀ or Δt > 0.03√(r³/(mᵢ+mⱼ)); the closest point along each drift segment is checked too. Stop before relative energy error exceeds 0.1%. Stellar collisions, tides, relativity and fits to observed data are not modeled.

interpretation.zh: 两轮轨迹分开，既要看初值变化，也要检查数值误差。有限时间的位置差不是混沌证明；小误差也不保证轨道位置永远准确。并非所有三体运动都混沌，八字与等边案例尤其用于对照。
interpretation.en: When trajectories separate, consider both the changed initial conditions and numerical error. A finite-time position difference is not proof of chaos; small conservation errors do not guarantee forever-accurate positions. Not every three-body motion is chaotic; the figure eight and triangle provide useful comparisons.

errorDefinition.zh: 能量误差 = |E−E₀| / max(|E₀|, 10⁻⁸(K₀+|U₀|))。动量与质心读数均对各自初值比较；数值以模型单位表示，两轮分别列出。
errorDefinition.en: Energy error = |E−E₀| / max(|E₀|, 10⁻⁸(K₀+|U₀|)). Momentum and center-of-mass readings compare with each run’s own initial state, in model units; both runs are listed separately.

sources.zh: 初值、原始论文与算法资料
sources.en: Initial conditions, original paper and algorithm

fallback.zh: 当前浏览器不能绘制画布，仍可计算并阅读下方初值与诊断数据。
fallback.en: Canvas is unavailable, but initial conditions and diagnostics remain accessible.
